universities.name: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology
universities.summary: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is a private, self-financing engineering college founded in 2007 at Ayyankoilpattu, Villupuram, Tamil Nadu, run by the E.S.S.M. Educational and Charitable Trust. It is not a university: it is a non-autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which sets its syllabus and exams and awards its degrees. It admitted to four AICTE-approved B.E./B.Tech branches through TNEA 2026.
universities.campusLifestyle: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET)'s campus is at E.S. Nagar on the Chennai Trunk Road (NH-45) at Ayyankoilpattu, on the northern edge of Villupuram. Its AICTE disclosure lists classrooms, tutorial rooms, department laboratories and a drawing hall, and its library holds about 45,000 volumes across seven engineering subjects. Boys' and girls' hostels are on campus and the college runs buses. The college also runs an annual technical symposium, Innobyte.
universities.cityProfile: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is at 3/249 E.S. Nagar, NH-45, Chennai Trunk Road, Ayyankoilpattu, Villupuram 605602, in Vikkiravandi taluk of Viluppuram district, Tamil Nadu. DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet places it 5 km from the district headquarters and 3 km from Villupuram railway station. Anna University lists it among Villupuram district colleges with code 4210.
universities.practicalExposure: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is not autonomous, so it follows Anna University's curricula and regulations: the university sets the syllabus, conducts the end-semester exams and awards the degree, and the college runs internal assessment. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student. An institution-industry cell arranges industrial visits, in-plant training and internships. ESCET's AICTE disclosure reports CSE and ECE campus offers of INR 1.25 lakh to 4 lakh a year (average INR 2.2 lakh) without placement counts.
universities.hostelOverview: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) has permanent on-campus hostels for men and women, according to DoTE's TNEA 2026 college booklet. The booklet lists room rent of INR 6,000 a year, electricity of INR 6,000 a year and mess charges of INR 60,800 a year, with a caution deposit of INR 5,000. The college publishes no separate hostel page, so confirm the current charges with the college.
universities.dietarySupport: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET)'s hostel messes serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food for men and women, according to DoTE's TNEA 2026 college booklet, which lists the mess charge at INR 60,800 a year. ESCET publishes no menu and no provision for specific regional or religious diets, so ask the hostel office before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET)'s AICTE disclosure lists an anti-ragging committee of faculty, student representatives, the administrative officer, the security officer and the ladies' hostel deputy warden, plus an internal complaints committee for sexual-harassment complaints and an SC/ST committee. TNEA 2026 publishes an anti-ragging phone number for the college (+91 97904 66108).
universities.studentSupport: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) handles grievances through an online grievance redressal mechanism, suggestion boxes on campus and in the hostels, class committee meetings and a student welfare officer. Its scholarship page lists Tamil Nadu welfare scholarships, the First Graduate scheme, the AICTE tuition fee waiver, the 7.5 per cent government-school scheme and Pudhumai Penn. Contact: admin@escet.in or +91 4146 294674.
whyChoose: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is a TNEA-listed Anna University college (code 1428) in Villupuram, so Class 12 students from the district can study a B.E. or B.Tech without leaving the district.
ESCET is 3 km from Villupuram railway station and 5 km from the district headquarters, according to DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet.
ESCET's hostel charges published in TNEA 2026 are low: room rent INR 6,000 and electricity INR 6,000 a year, with mess at INR 60,800 a year.
thingsToConsider: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is an affiliated, non-autonomous college, not a university: Anna University sets its syllabus and exams and awards its degrees, and there are no seats for international students because AICTE shows no NRI or foreign-national approval.

ESCET publishes no tuition fee, holds no NAAC grade, has no NBA-accredited branch and no NIRF rank, and after TNEA 2026 Round 1 DoTE still listed 286 government-quota vacancies across its four branches.
ESCET's website still lists B.E. Civil, B.E. EEE and B.E. Mechanical, but none of them was offered in TNEA 2026, so they are not listed here; check with the college before applying for them.
bestFitFor: Tamil Nadu TNEA applicants from Villupuram and nearby districts who want an Anna University B.E. or B.Tech close to home.
Students interested in computing branches: CSE, IT and AI and Data Science make up 300 of ESCET's 360 first-year places in TNEA 2026.
Students who need an on-campus hostel near Villupuram junction with published low room and electricity charges.

faq.question: Is E.S. College of Engineering and Technology autonomous or affiliated to Anna University?
faq.answer: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is a non-autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which sets its syllabus and exams and awards its degrees. Anna University lists it in Villupuram district with college code 4210, and DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet gives its autonomous status as No.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code for E.S. College of Engineering and Technology, Villupuram?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is 1428. In TNEA 2026 ESCET offered AI and Data Science (AD, 60 seats), Computer Science and Engineering (CS, 120), Electronics and Communication Engineering (EC, 60) and Information Technology (IT, 120).

faq.question: Is E.S. College of Engineering and Technology AICTE approved?
faq.answer: Yes, E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is AICTE approved as a private self-financing institution, permanent ID 1-3858465. Its latest published Extension of Approval, for 2025-26 (10 April 2025), covers seven B.E./B.Tech branches, all affiliated to Anna University, Chennai.

faq.question: What is the B.E. fee at E.S. College of Engineering and Technology?
faq.answer: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) does not publish its tuition; its disclosure says fees follow Government norms, so ask the college. Tamil Nadu's fee committee fixes tuition for self-financing colleges. TNEA 2026 lists an admission fee of INR 1,000, an establishment charge of INR 2,000 and transport at INR 12,000 to 30,000 a year.

faq.question: Does E.S. College of Engineering and Technology admit international or NRI students?
faq.answer: No, E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) has no NRI or foreign-national seats: AICTE's 2025-26 approval marks NRI and FN/Gulf/OCI approval as No or NA for every course. TNEA is for Indian nationals; OCI/PIO card holders who are natives of Tamil Nadu may apply unless born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: How do I get admission to E.S. College of Engineering and Technology?
faq.answer: Most B.E./B.Tech seats at E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) are filled through TNEA: register at tneaonline.org, get a rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), and choose code 1428. TNEA 2026 counselling ran 20 July to 30 August, and Anna University starts first-semester classes on 2 September 2026. Management-quota seats are filled by the college.

faq.question: Is E.S. College of Engineering and Technology NAAC or NBA accredited?
faq.answer: No, E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) holds no NAAC grade and no NBA accreditation: its AICTE mandatory disclosure records both as nil and not applied for, and DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet marks all four branches as not NBA accredited.

faq.question: Does E.S. College of Engineering and Technology have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes, E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) has permanent on-campus hostels for men and women with messes serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. TNEA 2026 lists room rent of INR 6,000, electricity of INR 6,000 and mess charges of INR 60,800 a year.

admissionsContent.overview: The B.Tech. Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) is a four-year, eight-semester degree taught in English in Villupuram. ESCET is a non-autonomous college, so Anna University sets the syllabus and exams and awards the degree. TNEA counselling on Class 12 marks fills 65 per cent of seats and the management quota 35 per cent; there is no entrance test.

eligibility.intro: TNEA 2026 sets these conditions for B.E./B.Tech admission; Anna University applies the same Government of Tamil Nadu norms to its affiliated colleges.
items: Pass in HSC (Class 11 and 12, academic stream) or equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
Minimum average in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry: 45 per cent for General category, 40 per cent for BC, BCM, MBC/DNC and SC/SCA/ST
HSC vocational candidates qualify with a listed engineering vocational subject and the same minimum averages
TNEA nativity rules apply: Tamil Nadu schooling for Classes 8 to 12, Tamil Nadu nativity certificate, or another listed category
Diploma holders, and B.Sc. graduates with Mathematics, may apply for lateral entry to the third semester under Government of Tamil Nadu norms

applicationSteps: Register and apply online at tneaonline.org (registration fee INR 500, or INR 250 for SC/SCA/ST); TNEA 2026 registration ran 3 May to 5 June 2026
Upload Class 10, 11 and 12 mark sheets, transfer certificate and any community, nativity, income or first-graduate certificates for verification
Check the TNEA rank, computed from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), on the published rank list
Fill choices online in your counselling round, entering college code 1428 with branch AD, then confirm the tentative allotment
Download the allotment order, report to ESCET within 5 days and pay the fees to complete admission
For a management-quota seat, apply to the college; ESCET says these seats follow the merit list of the Consortium of Self Financing Engineering Colleges (admission phone +91 94867 22474)

Diploma holders, and B.Sc. graduates with Mathematics, may apply for lateral entry to the third semester under Government of Tamil Nadu norms

applicationSteps: Register and apply online at tneaonline.org (registration fee INR 500, or INR 250 for SC/SCA/ST); TNEA 2026 registration ran 3 May to 5 June 2026
Upload Class 10, 11 and 12 mark sheets, transfer certificate and any community, nativity, income or first-graduate certificates for verification
Check the TNEA rank, computed from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), on the published rank list
Fill choices online in your counselling round, entering college code 1428 with branch IT, then confirm the tentative allotment
Download the allotment order, report to ESCET within 5 days and pay the fees to complete admission
For a management-quota seat, apply to the college; ESCET says these seats follow the merit list of the Consortium of Self Financing Engineering Colleges (admission phone +91 94867 22474)

academic: Class 12 (HSC second year) or equivalent mark sheet
application: Permanent community certificate where claiming reservation
Income certificate and first-graduate e-certificate where claiming concessions

programmes.feeNotes: E.S. College of Engineering and Technology (ESCET) publishes no tuition figure: its mandatory disclosure says only 'Fee - As per Government Norms' (checked 26 October 2026), and the TNEA 2026 college booklet prints no college-wise tuition, so tuition is on request from the college. Tamil Nadu's fee committee fixes tuition for self-financing engineering colleges. TNEA 2026 lists ESCET's other charges: admission fee INR 1,000, establishment charge INR 2,000, caution deposit INR 5,000, hostel room rent INR 6,000 a year, electricity INR 6,000 a year, mess INR 60,800 a year and college transport INR 12,000 to 30,000 a year.

teachingPhases.details: Anna University's Information Technology curriculum covering programming, data structures, database systems, web technologies, networks and cloud computing. Anna University sets the syllabus and end-semester exams; the college runs internal assessment and internship is mandatory.
